اعرنكسنا (form IIIq)
# اِعْرَنْكَسْنَا (iʕrankasnā) /iʕ.ran.kas.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِعْرَنْكَسَ (iʕrankasa)
# اُعْرُنْكِسْنَا (uʕrunkisnā) /uʕ.run.kis.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِعْرَنْكَسَ (iʕrankasa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
